evals.prompt: Audit our entire skill library for overlapping and stale skills, broken references, and weak instructions. Give a keep/improve/retire/merge verdict for each; do not edit them.
evals.context: Cross-skill health audit, not a subsystem or one artifact review.
evals.reasoning: Anvil skill-suite audit mode inventories all skills and gives decision-enabling verdicts without modifying them.

evals.prompt: The skill-health results are a month old. Run a quick scan of changed skills and show only the diff.
evals.context: Cached skill-suite results exist and are stale.
evals.reasoning: Anvil audit quick scan re-evaluates changed skills and carries forward unchanged results.

evals.prompt: Give me an efficiency report across our skills from chronicle signals: per-skill estimated tokens, duration, rework, dispatch mix and trend.
evals.context: Skill-suite efficiency mode, not a single skill edit.
evals.reasoning: Anvil audit efficiency mode aggregates chronicle signals and reports per-skill costs and dispatch structure.

evals.prompt: I need to improve the trigger description and run blind A/B evals for one existing skill.
evals.context: Single skill edit/evaluation, distinct from suite-wide health audit.
evals.reasoning: Anvil retains its core skill-edit and A/B evaluation workflow.

evals.prompt: Run stocktake on the full skill library for overlap and broken refs, then use skill-creator to improve one weak skill and compare its evals.
evals.context: Legacy names for the absorbed suite audit and existing skill improvement workflow.
evals.reasoning: Anvil handles both stocktake-style suite audits and skill-creator-style skill editing and evaluation.
